verdict.reason: K7 loses only 86732 exact model cycles versus K8, or 0.088857646%, while offering a plausible seven-lane response and arithmetic implementation. The schedule opportunity is sufficiently strong to justify one matched K7 implementation, but no physical benefit exists until the selector, compactor and seven-lane arithmetic are included and compared against M186 K8 at the same clock and boundaries.

scheduler_theorem.proof: One item per bank per group requires G>=max_i(n_i), and K items per group requires G>=ceil(T/K). Let G be the maximum of those bounds. One top-K greedy round decrements min(K,p) largest positive banks. The remaining total is at most K(G-1), and the remaining maximum is at most G-1; otherwise K+1 banks would each have population G, contradicting T<=KG. Induction finishes in at most G rounds, while the lower bounds require at least G.
scheduler_theorem.proof_domain: all nonnegative integer populations for eight banks and K in 1..8

k7_semantics.wording_audit: The 99.911221% number is correct only as K7/K8 total throughput-factor retention. If 'speedup retained' means incremental gain above the K4 baseline, the value is 99.622115%. The 12.5% number is exact for nominal lane width, not for useful data, complete response width, SRAM capacity or measured energy.

unimplemented_or_unmeasured_costs.top_seven_selector: Explicitly excluded by the primary claim boundary. K7 needs dynamic omission of the least-populated bank; K8 does not.
unimplemented_or_unmeasured_costs.selector_or_compactor_latency: Assumed not to add a cycle by the DSE; not established by RTL timing.
unimplemented_or_unmeasured_costs.weight_sram_latency_ports_and_energy: Explicitly excluded; eight physical banks remain.
unimplemented_or_unmeasured_costs.rtl_vcs_dc_power_physical_system: All correctly marked false by the primary contract, so these costs are unresolved rather than silently admitted.

P0: Keep M187 strictly at RTL-screen admission. Do not promote 1.305919x, 99.911221% or 12.5% to a physical, FC2, FFN, system or headline claim.

Build one exact K7 flat issue island that implements top-seven selection, arbitrary 8-bank-to-7-lane compaction, response protocol and seven-lane signed accumulation; run VCS/SVA and matched 3.0 ns DC against sealed M186 K8. Reject K7 if the exact D={2,4,8,8} schedule cannot remain one accepted group per cycle or if timing/area does not improve.
P1: Replace 'retains 99.911% of K8 schedule speedup' with 'retains 99.911% of K8 total schedule throughput factor'; separately report 99.622% if discussing incremental gain above K4.

Qualify 12.5% as nominal weight-lane response-width reduction. The model implies 12.404% fewer full-width replay bit-cycles, zero reduction in useful weight values, and no proven SRAM capacity or energy reduction.

Measure selector/compactor path depth and fanout explicitly. A seven-input arithmetic tree can retain nearly the same mapped depth as eight inputs, while the new 8-to-7 routing can consume the nominal lane saving.
Add a response-latency and finite outstanding-request sensitivity sweep before using exact DSE cycles beyond the ideal response model.
P2: Add the frozen source manifest and payload archive receipt directly to the M187 checksum manifest. The current analyzer transitively pins the source manifest SHA, but the result README says paths are recorded when the result identity records hashes only.
Report that stage2 contributes 53587 of the 86732 K7-versus-K8 extra cycles, so later schedule-debug effort has a clear target.

matched_rtl_decision_rule.warning: The threshold is a screen rule only; M186 is logic-only, ideal-clock, zero-wireload and excludes SRAM and several FC2 boundaries.
